newsitem.title: USA: Merck, Rhone to close Merial deal July 31.
newsitem.headline: Merck, Rhone to close Merial deal July 31.

text.p: Merck & Co Inc and Rhone-Poulenc said Thursday they plan to close the merger of their animal health and poultry genetics businesses on July 31.
The companies said they will form Merial Ltd, a 50-50 joint venture with a revenue base of $1.9 billion. They expect Merial to be operational August 1.

The companies said Merial will be solely dedicated to the discovery, manufacture and marketing of veterinary pharmaceuticals and vaccines. It will have a research and development budget of $120 million.
Worldwide headquarters will be in London, with main business centers in Lyon, France and Woodbridge, New Jersey, U.S.A.
Merial will provide a line of products and services for the prevention and treatment of diseases in livestock, poultry cats, dogs and horses.
Merial will have research and manufacturing aggreements with its parent companies.
